name: com.ooimi.expand.base.AutoInitializeContentProvider
description: OOIMI AndroidLibraryX sets up this Provider when the app starts so its helper library can retain the app context and current screen. The library uses that context for app-specific dp and sp sizing and other screen-aware helpers.
disableEffect: OOIMI helpers may lose the current screen context, and layouts using app-defined dimensions may fall back to system sizing.
